description: Move items to Google Photos' Trash, where they stay recoverable for 60 days. Never deletes permanently and cannot empty the Trash. Requires confirm=true; max 50 items per call. Show the user the exact items and get their yes first.

confirm.description: Must be true, after the user approved the exact items.

google_account_email.description: The signed-in Google account email whose Google Photos library to use (e.g. the one at /u/1/). Call list_accounts first and confirm with the user; do not guess.

media_keys.description: Up to 50 library media keys to move to Trash, JSON array or comma-separated.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

name: trash_media
